title: Uniform norm over the last coordinate
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real number $q>0$, and a function $f:\{-1,1\}^{n+1}\to\mathbb{R}$, define $g:\{-1,1\}^{n}\to\mathbb{R}$ by taking, at each $x$, the uniform $L^q$ quantity of the two values $f(x,-1)$ and $f(x,1)$. Then the uniform $L^q$ quantity of $f$ on $\{-1,1\}^{n+1}$ equals the uniform $L^q$ quantity of $g$ on $\{-1,1\}^{n}$.
